history.event: Claude refinement: 20 line(s) suggested — Corrected capital R/T/A misread as B/C/I (Rede, Testam̄to, taddeo, Ancora, Annone), garbled words (dottobre, avuto, febraio, marzo, eclesiastiche, benardino, tomaso), di read as d/𝒹 in dates, the ʒ-shaped 3 in the year 383, missing macrons/tildes (sc̄a, tēpo, comīciati, mãzo), and the dot–bar–dot half sign after ƒ 1 (written 1/1). | layout: l28: the box covers only part of the folio number in the circle at top right; the number reads 27; l11: the line begins with 'e' (efrati, continuing 'chiese' at the end of l10) and has a virgule after eclesiastiche; both added; l4: the line overlaps the box of l3 above | doubts: l17/l18: 'ƒ 1 ÷' looks like the dot–bar–dot sign (= one and a half florins, matching ƒ 3 a year split between two heirs); written 1/1 by rule. I could not decide whether the following '𝒹i' in l17 is denari or a stray 'di'; l16/l23: tomaso: Kraken read 'cōmaso'. The first letter is t, but I could not see a macron clearly; the word may be 'acomune' or 'a comune' run together; l14: 'il di dellamõ' (= il dì della morte, continued by 'te' in l15): the tilde over o is faint; l6: 'stricture' may be 'scricture'; I left it; l8: alloꝑa (= all'opera): the stroke runs through the descender of p, so ꝑ rather than ꝓ; l26: maffeo vs masseo (Laura wrote masseo in l19): ff and ss look the same in this hand; I left Kraken's form; l3: setēbre may be written settēbr with a final flourish; I left it
